result.topic_en: Reduction formulas for a torsion-balance magnetometer experiment: the scale value, the torsion ratio, oscillation periods of a loaded and unloaded needle, moments of inertia, the magnetic moment, and the horizontal intensity derived from deflection measurements.
result.transcription:

methods.what: Torsion ratio of the suspension from the scale shift per degree of torsion-circle rotation
Linear relation between squared oscillation period and squared distance of the added weights (fitted by least squares from three observations)
Product of horizontal intensity and magnetic moment from the oscillation data
Moment of inertia of the loaded needle
Moment of inertia of the unloaded needle
TM from the period of the unloaded needle with torsion correction
Deflection as a function of distance R in the south and north positions, as a series in odd inverse powers
Ratio M/T from the deflection coefficient a
Horizontal intensity T obtained by combining TM and M/T
